title: X-Men #6 Marvel 2013 Battle of the Atom Chapter 7 Brian Wood David Lopez
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear; back cover has light edge wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
X-Men #6 (2013, vol. 4), Marvel Comics - Battle of the Atom chapter 7. Brian Wood, David Lopez, Cam Smith and Laura Martin. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Harley-Davidson Fat Bob "Sick Day" ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear; light edge wear on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
